captions.detailed: This 3D model is a square end-cap plug designed to fit into a hollow square tube. It features a thin, flat outer flange at the base with rounded corners, and a taller, hollow square body that inserts into the tube. Two opposing vertical slots are cut into the upper portion of the inserting walls, allowing for pass-through access or alignment.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric square end-cap plug for a square tube with customizable outer diameter (bar_dia), wall thickness (wall_thick), plug insertion length (plug_length), and vertical alignment slots (slot_height, slot_width). Ensure the plug is hollowed out and has rounded corners on all square profiles.
captions.factory: The script defines a custom 'roundCornersCube' module which uses a 'createMeniscus' module (subtracting a cylinder from a cube) to bevel the vertical corners of a cube. The final part is constructed by unioning a thin base flange and a taller insertion block, both made from 'roundCornersCube'. This combined solid is then hollowed out by subtracting a smaller 'roundCornersCube', and the two side slots are cut out using a standard subtracted 'cube' primitive.
